question: ploidy
answer: 2 haplotype copies of each of 34 chromosome numbers; an older duplication shows on part of the genome (1% of the genome in homeolog blocks), too little to read duplicated sets from.
evidence: copies from the assembly (2 per number); 1% of the genome in homeolog blocks

question: origin_like_structure
answer: Not assessable: duplicated blocks are detected (homeology map), but no whole-chromosome homeolog pairs to read the copies across.
evidence: homeology map: 1% of the genome in blocks, 4 chromosome pairs; no whole-chromosome pairs

question: te_markers
answer: Only the absolute marker fraction is available (two copies per number); it does not separate diploid, auto- and allopolyploid, so no reading is made from it.

question: rediploidization
answer: Diverged throughout the paired chromosomes: no stretch where homeologs are as close as alleles. Rediploidization is complete, or the genome was allo-like from the start. Also: homeolog blocks diverged to different depths (CV 0.17), as when regions resolve at different times.
evidence: residual tetrasomy on 0/8 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers; homeology map: 1% of the genome in 9 homeolog blocks, 4 chromosome pairs, block-divergence CV 0.17
